lines.speaker: Cupcake
lines.english: This pudding looks so cute! Should I buy it?
lines.japanese: このプリン、かわいい！買おうかな？
lines.romaji: Kono purin, kawaii! Kaou kana?

lines.speaker: Coffee Mug
lines.english: Yes! And get a spoon too.
lines.japanese: うん！スプーンももらってね。
lines.romaji: Un! Supuun mo moratte ne.

lines.speaker: Cupcake
lines.english: Let's finish work early and chill together.
lines.japanese: 早く仕事を終わらせて、一緒にのんびりしよう。
lines.romaji: Hayaku shigoto o owarasete, issho ni nonbiri shiyou.

lines.speaker: Coffee Mug
lines.english: Deal! First, let's take a tiny coffee break.
lines.japanese: いいね！まず、小さなコーヒー休憩しよう。
lines.romaji: Ii ne! Mazu, chiisana koohii kyuukei shiyou.

lines.speaker: Cupcake
lines.english: This melon bread smells so good!
lines.japanese: このメロンパン、いいにおい！
lines.romaji: Kono meron pan, ii nioi!

lines.speaker: Coffee Mug
lines.english: Let’s buy one and share it.
lines.japanese: 一つ買って、半分こしよう。
lines.romaji: Hitotsu katte, hanbunko shiyou.

lines.speaker: Cupcake
lines.english: If I sit next to you, will your heart get warm?
lines.japanese: となりに座ったら、心もあったかくなる？
lines.romaji: Tonari ni suwattara, kokoro mo attakaku naru?

lines.speaker: Coffee Mug
lines.english: Yes, because you’re my favorite sweet.
lines.japanese: うん、君は僕の一番好きなスイーツだから。
lines.romaji: Un, kimi wa boku no ichiban suki na suiitsu dakara.

lines.speaker: Cupcake
lines.english: If I share my frosting, will you share your heart?
lines.japanese: クリームをあげたら、心もくれる？
lines.romaji: Kuriimu o agetara, kokoro mo kureru?

lines.speaker: Coffee Mug
lines.english: Only if you sit next to me every morning.
lines.japanese: 毎朝となりに座ってくれたらね。
lines.romaji: Maiasa tonari ni suwatte kuretara ne.

lines.speaker: Cupcake
lines.english: Do you want to go on a date with me today?
lines.japanese: 今日、私とデートしない？
lines.romaji: Kyou, watashi to deeto shinai?

lines.speaker: Coffee Mug
lines.english: Yes! Being with you is the sweetest.
lines.japanese: うん！君といると一番甘いよ。
lines.romaji: Un! Kimi to iru to ichiban amai yo.

dialogue.topic: Cute reaction to a tiny heart in coffee foam

lines.speaker: Cupcake
lines.english: Wow, there's a tiny heart in your foam! So cute!
lines.japanese: わあ、泡に小さいハートがある！かわいい！
lines.romaji: Waa, awa ni chiisai haato ga aru! Kawaii!

lines.speaker: Coffee Mug
lines.english: Hehe, it showed up because I saw you.
lines.japanese: へへ、君を見たから出てきたよ。
lines.romaji: Hehe, kimi o mita kara dete kita yo.

lines.speaker: Cupcake
lines.english: Which rice ball should I get? The salmon one is calling me!
lines.japanese: どのおにぎりにしよう？しゃけが呼んでる！
lines.romaji: Dono onigiri ni shiyou? Shake ga yonderu!

lines.speaker: Coffee Mug
lines.english: Then I'll get hot coffee. Let's have a tiny picnic outside.
lines.japanese: じゃあ、ぼくはホットコーヒー。外で小さなピクニックしよう。
lines.romaji: Jaa, boku wa hotto koohii. Soto de chiisana pikunikku shiyou.

lines.speaker: Character A (Cupcake)
lines.english: This ribbon is so cute! Does it look good on me?
lines.japanese: このリボン、すごくかわいい！私に似合う？
lines.romaji: Kono ribon, sugoku kawaii! Watashi ni niau?

lines.speaker: Character B (Coffee Mug)
lines.english: Yes, it looks great! Let's buy matching ones.
lines.japanese: うん、似合うよ！おそろいで買おう。
lines.romaji: Un, niau yo! Osoroi de kaou.

lines.speaker: Cupcake
lines.english: That taiyaki looks so Insta-worthy!
lines.japanese: あのたい焼き、映えるね！
lines.romaji: Ano taiyaki, baeru ne!

lines.speaker: Coffee Mug
lines.english: Let’s share it while it’s hot.
lines.japanese: 熱いうちに半分こしよ。
lines.romaji: Atsui uchi ni hanbunko shiyo.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Harajuku is so sparkly!
lines.japanese: 原宿、キラキラだね！
lines.romaji: Harajuku, kirakira da ne!

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: You stand out more.
lines.japanese: 君のほうが映えてるよ。
lines.romaji: Kimi no hou ga haeteru yo.

dialogue.topic: A tiny cat marshmallow in coffee

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: That tiny cat marshmallow is sleeping inside the cup.
lines.japanese: その 小さな 猫の マシュマロ、 カップの 中で 眠って いますね。
lines.romaji: Sono chiisana neko no mashumaro, kappu no naka de nemutte imasu ne.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, it gently cools the hot coffee for me.
lines.japanese: はい、 熱い コーヒーを 少し 冷まして くれるん です。
lines.romaji: Hai, atsui koohii o sukoshi samashite kurerun desu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: It is so cute that even I want to pet it softly.
lines.japanese: かわいすぎて、 私まで 静かに なでたく なって しまいます よ。
lines.romaji: Kawaisugite, watashi made shizuka ni nadetaku natte shimaimasu yo.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: After you take a photo, please enjoy it slowly with me.
lines.japanese: 写真を 撮ったら、 一緒に ゆっくり 味わって ください ね。
lines.romaji: Shashin o tottara, issho ni yukkuri ajiwatte kudasai ne.

dialogue.topic: A tiny sugar star makes the cupcake feel special.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Look, a tiny sugar star is sitting on top of me.
lines.japanese: 見て、私の上に小さな砂糖の星が乗っています。
lines.romaji: Mite, watashi no ue ni chiisana satou no hoshi ga notte imasu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That is true, and it is so cute, so let's take a photo.
lines.japanese: 本当ですね、とてもかわいいから写真を撮りましょう。
lines.romaji: Hontou desu ne, totemo kawaii kara shashin o torimashou.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I feel a little shy, but I am happy like today's star.
lines.japanese: 少し恥ずかしいですが、今日は主役みたいで嬉しいです。
lines.romaji: Sukoshi hazukashii desu ga, kyou wa shuyaku mitai de ureshii desu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Do not worry; when you smile, the cream and star shine more.
lines.japanese: 大丈夫です、笑うとクリームも星ももっと輝きますよ。
lines.romaji: Daijoubu desu, warau to kuriimu mo hoshi mo motto kagayakimasu yo.

dialogue.topic: Travel & Transit: Cupcake and Coffee Mug go to the station

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Where is the station?
lines.japanese: えきは どこですか？
lines.romaji: Eki wa doko desu ka?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Over there. It's close.
lines.japanese: あそこです。ちかいです。
lines.romaji: Asoko desu. Chikai desu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: What time is the train?
lines.japanese: でんしゃは なんじですか？
lines.romaji: Densha wa nanji desu ka?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: At three. Let's go!
lines.japanese: さんじです。いきましょう！
lines.romaji: Sanji desu. Ikimashou!

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I'm sleepy today.
lines.japanese: きょう、ねむいです。
lines.romaji: Kyou, nemui desu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: For real? Coffee, here!
lines.japanese: まじ？コーヒー、どうぞ！
lines.romaji: Maji? Koohii, douzo!

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Wow, I'm energetic now!
lines.japanese: わあ、いま げんきです！
lines.romaji: Waa, ima genki desu!

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Okay, let's go!
lines.japanese: よし、いこう！
lines.romaji: Yoshi, ikou!
